mandatory_post_fix_governance_doc_sync.policy: Whenever a bug fix, root-cause remediation, or new pipeline invariant is implemented, the agent MUST immediately update all canonical governance and skill documents in lockstep within the same task so no rule ever creeps out of sync.

state_management.persisted_state_store: PostgreSQL table reel_operations (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

hardware_budgets.applicability: ADVISORY_ONLY - all generation models are remote HTTP APIs; no local GPU/VRAM is consumed.

skill_routing_matrix.binding_note: required_skill values are literal skill DIRECTORY identifiers under ~/.gemini/config/skills/ or <project_root>/skills/. Prose titles cannot bind and resolve to undefined.

dynamic_model_orchestration.authority: Google Omni 1.1 decides model invocation, execution DAG order, context schemas, and remediation triggers.

model_inventory.audio_composition: DeepMind Lyria 3.5 (generated master) OR Master Studio Track Ingestion (real recorded 48kHz)

coordination_rules: 1. Omni 1.1 formulates an execution DAG based on request modality, project domain, and target aspect ratio.
2. Biometric anchors and master audio stems are validated prior to initiating video rendering passes.
3. Intermediate JSON/AST schemas are strictly validated prior to downstream model invocation.
4. Gemini 2.5 Pro conducts independent forensic audits to detect temporal warping, plastic skin, or artificial mouth artifacts.
5. Schema or runtime errors trigger context-aware exponential retries up to 3 attempts before routing to the DLQ.

provenance_ledger.emit_from: the single outbound model HTTP wrapper - no model call may bypass it
assertions: execution_order is satisfied only if the receipt stage sequence is a topological order of the declared DAG.
skill_routing_matrix is satisfied only if each receipt model equals the assigned_model for that stage.
omniLedger.modelsInvoked MUST be derived from receipts and MUST NEVER be hand-authored.
A stage declared in execution_order with zero receipts is a HARD FAIL.
Stage 0 (Omni 1.1 director) MUST have a receipt with http_status 200 before any generative API spend. No receipt = production invalid.
provenance_ledger.unimplemented_models_note: Kling 3.0, Sora 2 and Sync.so / Flashloop are declared in model_inventory but no client exists in this codebase. Under ban_self_reported_model_attribution they may NOT be cited in any ledger until a real client emits receipts.

removed_stages.Sync.so / Flashloop Engine: No client exists. Under ban_self_reported_model_attribution this stage could never be truthfully receipted, so declaring it would guarantee a false ledger.
removed_stages.Demucs Vocal Separator: Not installed. Vocal stem isolation is unavailable; require_vocal_stem_isolation_preflight is therefore scoped to productions that supply pre-separated stems.

director_policy.rationale: The previous callOmni() swallowed errors and returned null while callers proceeded, so a production could run entirely undirected yet still record Omni 1.1 in its ledger. A director that can be skipped is not a director.

music_video_correctness.source_audit: omni_guard_v2.6.0_gap_audit.md (9 blindspots), still absent in v4.1.0

spectrum.rationale: highpass=f=200 gutted the kick, sub-bass and synth groove and produced the tinny master. Full 35Hz-20kHz spectrum must survive.

music_video_correctness.tilt_incident_reference: shot_03 of studio1_d5dbfcf2 shipped rotated 90 degrees. No rule covered this.
music_video_correctness.poster_incident_reference: MyReelsLibrary.tsx:1069 fell back to a stock beach still, surfacing a man in a white shirt as the thumbnail of a reel he does not appear in.
music_video_correctness.crop_incident_reference: sm:aspect-video forced 9:16 clips into 16:9 boxes and cropped every head.

bpm_grid_enforcement.note: Cut boundaries must land on bar downbeats. At 118 BPM a bar is 2033.9ms, so 6.0s cuts drift 102-407ms and would fail the gate. Shot lengths must be integer multiples of the bar.

environmental_shot_character_id_sanitiza.incident_reference: Take #1 of studio1_b8068f5e had onCameraCharacterId='scene', triggering PRECONDITION_FAILED: Canonical character reference image missing for character scene.

multi_component_4_clock_drift_gate.incident_reference: renderRough native-audio path used actualDurationSec (8.0s Veo buckets) without trim/atrim filters, stitching 17 shots into 128.12s against a 34.52s song (+93.6s drift).

cross_environment_asset_verification_par.incident_reference: verify-assets checked only local fs.existsSync, showing false NO MEDIA badge on localhost:3000/my-reels for Railway-proxied studio1_* reels.

rules.master_audio_source_note: A Lyria-generated master satisfies this rule ONLY if the Lyria API was physically invoked and a provenance receipt exists. Synthetic oscillators, noise generators and static tones remain banned under Rule 12.
rules.anchor_source_note: A generated anchor is permitted because every shot is image-conditioned from that single plate, which is what preserves biometric identity. Pure text-to-video face generation (no anchor image) remains prohibited.
rules.vocal_stem_isolation_disabled_reason: Demucs is not installed on either machine. Re-enable once a real separator client exists.

SessionStart.disabled_reason: Handler .claude/hooks/session_start.py does not exist in any project. Re-enable once a real handler is present.

canonical_source.note: Exactly one hooks.json exists system-wide across all projects. Every other location is a symlink to this file or must not exist. Enforced by scripts/guards/guard_single_hooks_source.mjs.
